title: MPQ: A Message-Passing View of Post-Training Quantization
abstract: arXiv:2610.32127v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) is a key technique for efficiently deploying large language models, as it compresses weights into low-bit representations without retraining. Existing PTQ solvers, including GPTQ, LDLQ, and block coordinate descent, commit each weight block to a single codeword before its neighbors are considered, leaving near-optimal alternatives unexplored. In this work, we cast row-wise PTQ as posterior inference over discrete codebooks, in which existing solvers correspond to a zero-temperature, hard-decision limit retaining only the top codeword per block. We propose Message-Passing Quantization (MPQ), which preserves soft posterior information across blocks during inference and commits to hard codewords only at the output stage. MPQ first uses vector approximate message passing to compute approximate blockwise posteriors, then refines a hard-decision initialization by exact block coordinate descent. Across 2-bit lat

translated_title: MPQ：训练后量化的消息传递视角
translated_abstract: 训练后量化（PTQ）是高效部署大语言模型的关键技术，因为它无需重新训练即可将权重压缩为低比特表示。现有的PTQ求解器，包括GPTQ、LDLQ和块坐标下降法，都会在考虑相邻权重块之前就把每个权重块固定为单个码字，使得接近最优的备选方案未被探索。在这项工作中，我们将逐行PTQ转化为对离散码本的后验推断问题，其中现有求解器对应于零温度、硬判决的极限情况，即每个块仅保留最优码字。我们提出消息传递量化（MPQ），它在推断过程中跨块保留软后验信息，并仅在输出阶段才固定为硬码字。MPQ首先使用向量近似消息传递来计算近似的逐块后验分布，然后通过精确的块坐标下降法来精炼硬判决初始化结果。在2比特……
tldr: 该论文提出消息传递量化（MPQ），将训练后量化重新建模为离散码本上的后验推断，通过在权重块间传递软后验信息并在最后阶段才做硬判决，从而超越GPTQ等现有硬判决求解器，提升大语言模型低比特量化的精度。
en_tdlr: MPQ recasts post-training quantization as posterior inference over discrete codebooks, preserving soft posterior information across weight blocks via message passing and committing to hard codewords only at the output stage, outperforming existing hard-decision PTQ solvers like GPTQ for low-bit LLM compression.
